PERSONAL LOG // GRIK
Encryption: LOW

Timestamp: 18:42 Local



Another meeting.

 Czerka calls them "strategic planning sessions." I call them wasted hunting time. Humans and executives love talking. Charts. Budgets. Percentages. Risk assessments. Three hours of arguing over who gets credit for work I'll end up doing anyway.
If I hear the phrase "synergize operational assets" one more time, someone is losing a hand.

Still...

The credits clear every cycle. On time.

That buys good armor, good fuel, and good ammunition. 

Can't complain too much. 

I finally got approval for leave after this contract wraps up.



No targets. No clients. No quotas. 

Just me, the blaster, and whatever dangerous thing thinks it owns the wilderness.

 I've been hearing stories about some oversized predator out beyond the settlements. Big enough to leave claw marks in durasteel. 

Might just be local legends.

 Hope not. 

It's been too long since I hunted something that could actually fight back.

That's what reminds you you're alive.

If Czerka wants me back after that, they can schedule all the meetings they want.

As long as they keep paying.
